onboarding.introText1: Welcome to OurGrid. Through challenges and useful tips, we help you become aware of your electricity consumption and encourage you to optimize your consumption.
onboarding.introText2: Join our community of energy-conscious users and make a difference for the future!
onboarding.page2-text1: Most people use the most electricity in the morning and evening. But their solar panels deliver the most during the day.
onboarding.page2-text2: This leads to large differences and peak loads on the electricity grid, the network is not designed for this.
onboarding.page2-text3: Spreading your consumption is important to relieve the network and promote more sustainable use.
onboarding.page3-text: The connected dongle gives you live insight into your own consumption. If the network is in danger of becoming overloaded, your screen will turn red.

privacy-statement:
With the OurGrid app we use your energy consumption data for the following purposes: giving you personal insight into your own consumption; predicting neighbourhood consumption; determining which challenges we send to which user, and keeping track of your earned points. Your energy consumption data is automatically deleted after 3 months. We store your earned points for one calendar year.

Your anonymised energy consumption data is only shared with your city, OpenRemote, and Resourcefully. These organisations only use this data to: use the power values for preventing network congestion, further improving the application, and to ensure the application functions properly.

If you want data deleted, you can always disconnect the dongle from your meter and delete your account. All meter data automatically gets deleted after three months.
